name: ultra-dev-plugin
description: A controlled feature-development workflow for Claude Code. Chains four core skills (brainstorm, spec-writing, spec-to-plan, executing-plan) with the human driving every transition, plus aux skills (research, code-review, test-writing, doc-writing, erd-writing) that run on demand. The project-docs and user-manual-writing skills are slash-only (`/project-docs`, `/user-manual-writing`) and never auto-trigger. The research skill expects the user-installed context7 MCP plugin to be available.
